daily.today_energy: The universe is giving you permission to pause and recalibrate. Your vibe is introspective but intentional—like you're finally listening to what your soul's been trying to say. Trust the quiet moments today.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the shift in your energy, and honestly? It's magnetic. Whether you're single or coupled, lean into authenticity over people-pleasing. Real connection happens when you stop performing.
daily.career: Your ideas have more weight than you think. This is a day to advocate for yourself without guilt—your perspective adds real value to the table. Share what you've been holding back.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness, not intensity. Nourish yourself with things that feel good rather than things that feel productive. Movement, rest, whatever grounds you—it all counts.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to trust your gut more than your overthinking brain. Venus is playing in your favor, bringing unexpected moments of clarity. Things that felt stuck are starting to shift—stay open to the plot twist.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, there's a softness in the air around you. If you're in something, deeper conversations are calling. Single? Someone interesting might slide into your orbit. Either way, lead with authenticity.
weekly.career: Your creative ideas are actually hitting different right now. This is the time to pitch that thing you've been sitting on or take on a project that excites you. Your confidence is the real asset here.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Rest isn't lazy—it's strategic. Movement that feels good (not punishment) will vibe with your energy. Listen to what your body actually wants.
